titulo: Gold Steadies After Weekly Drop as Focus Shifts to Fed Meeting
resumen: Gold steadied after its biggest weekly drop since June, with traders weighing stubbornly high energy prices ahead of the Federal Reserve’s upcoming policy meeting.

titulo: Goldman Says Yen Becoming Better Hedge Against AI Market Shock
resumen: The yen is becoming a more effective hedge against an artificial intelligence-driven market shock as changes in Japan’s policy backdrop reduce the risk of the currency weakening sharply when global yields rise, according to Goldman Sachs.

titulo: Baht to Rebound on Inflows Into Nation’s Bonds, Analysts Say
resumen: Thailand’s baht may be nearing a turning point after a bruising eight months, with analysts seeing scope for a rebound as foreign money returns to the nation’s bonds and an improving current account supports the currency.

titulo: Lula Wins a Record Fourth Term in Brazil in a Surprise Comeback
resumen: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva came from behind to win Brazil’s runoff election, halting a right-wing wave sweeping Latin America and defying predictions that the 80-year-old political veteran had finally reached the end of his extraordinary career.

titulo: SK Hynix Plans $12 Billion Dividend From Kioxia Gains: Report
resumen: SK Hynix Inc. plans to return about 80% of the gains from selling down its stake in Japan’s Kioxia Holdings Corp. to shareholders through a special dividend of about 16 trillion won ($12 billion), the DongA Ilbo newspaper reported.

titulo: Asia’s Busiest Earnings Week Puts AI Boom in Focus After Selloff
